description: This file is a Swift source extension for the CritterStatusLabel, adding visual and behavioral logic for macOS SwiftUI views, including animations, state handling, and UI components.

methods.name: isWorkingNow
methods.description: Computed property determining if the critter is currently working based on icon state.

methods.name: effectiveAnimationsEnabled
methods.description: Computed property indicating if animations should be enabled, considering sleep state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: SwiftUI View representing the critter status indicator with dynamic visual updates based on state.

methods.name: tickTaskID
methods.description: Unique identifier for the periodic animation task, dependent on animation and boost states.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Updates the critter's animation states based on the current time.

methods.name: iconImage
methods.description: Generates the current icon image based on state, including sleep, pause, and badge indicators.

methods.name: resetMotion
methods.description: Resets all motion-related animation variables to their default state.

methods.name: blink
methods.description: Performs a blinking animation with timing control.

methods.name: wiggle
methods.description: Performs a wiggle animation of the icon with spring physics.

methods.name: scheduleRandomTimers
methods.description: Schedules timers for various animations at random intervals.

methods.name: gatewayNeedsAttention
methods.description: Determines if the gateway requires user attention based on status.

methods.name: gatewayBadgeColor
methods.description: Returns the appropriate color badge for the gateway status.
